text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-8642 fired for inference-eu-prod — elevated latency + 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings (link: https://pagerduty.com/PD-8642)
ryan: acked. I'm on it.
sophie: thx ryan — are customers seeing errors or just latency?
ryan: both. p95 spiked to ~1.2s and a small but growing number of 504s since 21:12 UTC. appears concentrated in eu region.
alex: copying runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-latency (see mitigation checklist)
maria: fwiw alerts show a correlation with k/v cache eviction events around the same time. possible kvcache thrash.
ryan: plan: 1) add two nodes to eu-embed-pool 2) enable fallback routing to quantized-small-embed for tail requests 3) temporarily relax batching for that route. will update as I go.
ryan: running scale command now:
```
infractl scale pool eu-embed-pool --add 2 --reason "PD-8642 latency spike"
```
sophie: I'll prep customer-facing note if we confirm impact. ping me once you know which tenants affected.
support-bot: Created ticket RED-1234 for customer cust-232 reporting 504s. Assigned to support-oncall.
ryan: scale command issued. adding fallback route in router config:
```
routerctl set-route embeddings-eu fallback_model=quantized-small-embed threshold_ms=800
```
maria: grafana panels: https://grafana.redwood/boards/embeddings-eu — p95 graph updated. watching kvcache eviction histogram.
ryan: 21:18 UTC — pool scaling completed. nodes joined. initial latency improvement visible (p95 -> ~450ms). still seeing isolated 504s for cust-232.
ryan: 21:22 UTC — fallback routing enabled. 504s dropped for most flows. customer cust-232 still has intermittent errors, support digging.
sophie: thanks. I'll draft a short status for affected customers: "We're seeing elevated latency in EU, mitigation in progress; some customers may have experienced transient errors; engineers have scaled capacity and enabled fallbacks." want me to send?
ryan: yes please. include ETA: continuing monitoring, expect stable in 30m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8642 acknowledged by ryan. Escalation timer paused.
alex: noting action items for the followup postmortem: investigate kvcache eviction root cause, autoscaler response time, and whether fallback routing should be automatic for certain SLAs.
ryan: 21:34 UTC — metrics look stable. handing off to sophie for monitoring and customer comms; my oncall shift ends in 20m. sophie, take ownership please?
sophie: I accept ownership. will monitor for 60m and coordinate with support to confirm cust-232 resolved. please DM logs and any query IDs I should watch. :thumbsup: 
ryan: DMing query IDs and server logs now. leaving notes in the PD incident and the runbook.
support-bot: Ticket RED-1234 updated: customer cust-232 reports issue resolved at 21:40 UTC.
sophie: confirmed cust-232 back to normal. continuing monitoring for another 30m then will close the PD incident unless it flares.
ryan: thanks all — great quick team response. I'll add detailed timeline to the incident doc.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8642: status -> under_monitoring.
